title.narrative: GC7: Scaling Up Malaria Prevention, Treatment, and Control Interventions in Liberia for Sustained Impact.

description.narrative: Liberia - Malaria - Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops - CRS Liberia. This program has the following goals: By end of 2025, reduce malaria burden by 75% (11% overall prevalence) compared to 2016 (45% prevalence). The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: By end of 2025, reduce malaria mortality rates by at least 75% (43/100,000 population) compared to 2016 (172/100,000 population). Objective 2: By end of 2025, reduce malaria case incidence by at least 75% (95/1,000 population) compared to 2016 (380/1,000 population). Objective 3: By end of 2025, promote and maintain a culture of evidence-based decision making to achieve malaria program performance at all levels.
